# Patterns excluded from `rsync --delete` deploys.
#
# These patterns serve two purposes:
#   1. Files matched here are NOT transferred from the runner.
#   2. Files matched here are NOT removed on the destination by --delete.
#
# Anything that should live only on the server (env files, runtime logs,
# server-managed state) MUST be listed here so it isn't wiped on deploy.

# --- VCS / CI / agent metadata ---
.git/
.github/
.gitignore
.gitattributes
.serena/
.worktrees/
.claude/

# --- IDE / local tooling ---
.vscode/
.idea/
.phpunit.cache/
.phpcs.cache

# --- Tests, coverage, dev-only sources ---
tests/
coverage/
docs/

# --- Sibling deploy lanes (managed by their own pipelines, not this rsync) ---
# services/embedding is a long-running FastAPI service; it has its own
# lifecycle (Python venv, model download, systemd restart) and is deployed
# under a dedicated non-chrooted user. scripts/compute_embeddings.py is an
# offline batch job run on demand from a local checkout.
services/
scripts/

# --- Build / dev configuration that has no runtime role ---
phpcs.xml
phpcs.xml.dist
phpstan.neon
phpstan.neon.dist
phpunit.xml
phpunit.xml.dist
captainhook.json
redocly.yaml
docker-compose.yml
docker-compose.yaml
Dockerfile
docker-entrypoint.sh
.dockerignore

# --- Local dev scripts (not used in production) ---
start-server.sh
stop-server.sh
restart-server.sh
server.pid
server.vscode.pid
# Router script for PHP's built-in dev server (`php -S`); Apache routes
# through index.php directly, so this file is never loaded in production.
/public/router.php

# --- Project meta files (optional; comment out to deploy them) ---
CLAUDE.md
README.md

# --- SERVER-MANAGED FILES (never overwrite, never --delete) ---
# Exception: ship .env.example so server admins can diff it against the
# live .env to spot new or deprecated environment variables. The `+ `
# prefix makes this an include override; it must appear BEFORE the
# matching `.env.*` exclude below since rsync uses first-match-wins.
+ .env.example
.env
.env.*
dbcredentials.php
logs/
